delegate.name: generate_image
delegate.description: Generate one PNG, or a reference-guided edit, on the owner's ChatGPT subscription whatever model or harness calls it: the machine's OpenCode ChatGPT login, never API-key billing or another provider

delegate.name: list_delegate_types
delegate.description: The live delegate catalog, the one a named delegate's dispatch reads: each type's task description, harness, model, effort, skills, denied tools and whether it may delegate

delegate.name: list_sessions
delegate.description: The other sessions on the fleet, each with the directory and machine it works in, then the machines online now by the names `machine` takes on delegate and start_session

delegate.name: handoff
delegate.description: Send a message to another session on the fleet: guide one of your delegates while its work item runs, or brief a session that already owns the work

delegate.name: wait_item
delegate.description: Declare a bounded wait on a command you started, then end your turn

delegate.name: finish_item
delegate.description: Finish your work item

delegate.name: send_to_user
delegate.description: Show the user a message on their Telegram: progress, partial results, or content they must see exactly as written before the task finishes

delegate.name: open_items
delegate.description: Your open items, word for word, as every compaction lists them.

delegate.name: set_title
delegate.description: Name this session in 3 to 6 plain words, verb first if it is a task (e.g

delegate.name: show_image
delegate.description: Show an image file to the user inline in this session's transcript, by path

delegate.name: artifact_list
delegate.description: Your artifacts (a lead: its project's too), newest first: shown, opened, open pins, unread changes, picks, and `waitingOn` person or session

delegate.name: artifact_create
delegate.description: Make an artifact and open it in your panel

delegate.name: artifact_update
delegate.description: Change one of your artifacts in place

delegate.name: artifact_read
delegate.description: Read the person's picks, notes and values on one of your artifacts, each with the page hash it was made on

delegate.name: components_list
delegate.description: Your workspace's components a sheet can show, and each one's story files.

delegate.name: artifact_show
delegate.description: Bring one of your artifacts to the front of your panel for the person to look at again

delegate.name: artifact_promote
delegate.description: Keep an artifact worth keeping with your project: commits it to artifacts/<name>/ in the project's folder, which outlives this session

delegate.name: artifact_delete
delegate.description: Remove an artifact of yours a newer one superseded, once that one is up

delegate.name: comment_read
delegate.description: Read the person's pins on your artifacts: each numbered, its anchor (selector, file:line, text, ink box), its thread

delegate.name: comment_reply
delegate.description: Answer a pin in its thread on the page

delegate.name: comment_resolve
delegate.description: Resolve a pin once your change answers it, with a last line when it helps

delegate.name: task_read
delegate.description: Your project's tasks

delegate.name: todo_write
delegate.description: Two scopes

delegate.name: task_comment
delegate.description: Comment on your work item's task (a session the operator started names any): an entry with your name and the time, never changed.

delegate.name: task_result
delegate.description: Hand in your task's work before finish_item: what you did, what to check, what you made

delegate.name: folder_read
delegate.description: Read a file, or list a folder (no path: the root), of your project's folder on the hub.

delegate.name: memory_note
delegate.description: A lasting fact for this project's later sessions (a convention, command, decision, place), not a step of your task, into its inbox; the person decides what is kept.

delegate.name: design_write
delegate.description: Write files of the project's design/ system, as the design-system skill says
